usage: campaign.py [-h] --config CONFIG [--workspace WORKSPACE] --vtr-root
                   VTR_ROOT [--mapping-vtr-root MAPPING_VTR_ROOT] --binary
                   BINARY --backend-manifest BACKEND_MANIFEST
                   --qualification-report QUALIFICATION_REPORT --out OUT
                   --scratch SCRATCH [--jobs JOBS] [--rrg-jobs RRG_JOBS]
                   [--per-job-mib PER_JOB_MIB] [--rrg-mib RRG_MIB]
                   [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--threads THREADS]
                   [--timing-id TIMING_ID] [--device DEVICE] [--allow-local]
                   {plan,prepare,calibrate,teachers,pretrain,feedback,finetune,validate,pilot,scan,timing,resident,report}

CPU/GPU stage hand-off for the registered three-method 3D experiment. Every
completed stage has immutable input signatures. No held-out teacher or test-
time candidate selection is permitted. P&R feedback and controlled timing are
separate queues. Long stages are intended for the server, not local smoke.

positional arguments:
  {plan,prepare,calibrate,teachers,pretrain,feedback,finetune,validate,pilot,scan,timing,resident,report}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --workspace WORKSPACE
  --vtr-root VTR_ROOT
  --mapping-vtr-root MAPPING_VTR_ROOT
                        read-only same-commit full VTR with ABC/Yosys;
                        defaults to vtr-root
  --binary BINARY
  --backend-manifest BACKEND_MANIFEST
  --qualification-report QUALIFICATION_REPORT
  --out OUT
  --scratch SCRATCH
  --jobs JOBS
  --rrg-jobs RRG_JOBS
  --per-job-mib PER_JOB_MIB
  --rrg-mib RRG_MIB
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --threads THREADS
  --timing-id TIMING_ID
  --device DEVICE
  --allow-local
